gate_semantics.evidence_acquisition_gate: A domain may proceed when it is implemented and preserves supported evidence plus explicit UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE/UNPROVEN states without fabrication. Downstream corpus obligations do not block collection of prerequisite evidence.
gate_semantics.final_completion_gate: No full Machine-2 completeness claim until every applicable CURRENT Master/OWNER domain is closed, proven unavailable/not-applicable with reason, or completed at its admitted downstream stage with exact readback.

exact_time_known_at_formation_eligibilit.reason: Actual source timestamp is preserved. Where bar-completion/KNOWN_AT semantics are not proven, current objects persist UNKNOWN_UNPROVEN rather than guessing or backdating. This is valid evidence acquisition but not final timing completeness.

effort_response_nonresponse.reason: Volume/value/NBSS response objects and negative evidence exist; V3 adds full lineage/availability and no unsupported semantic direction is forced.

attempts_retests_loops_nested_episodes.reason: V3 extension preserves objective fresh-extreme/open-cross attempts, state revisits and exact close-level revisits. Attack/defense/nested semantic meaning remains unforced unless evidence/definition supports it.

state_maturity_persistence_decay.reason: V3 records state start/end, actual-row persistence, elapsed time, recurrence/reappearance; maturity/decay/exhaustion labels remain unforced absent governed thresholds/definitions.

lead_lag_relationship_graph.reason: V3 records objective lane-change events, first observed mover, row/time lag, direction and event counts while explicitly not equating observed order with causation.

market_sector_cross_sectional_mechanism_.reason: V3 carries context registry and explicit UNKNOWN/PARTIAL states. Source-supported context must be attached when discovered; unavailable/unproven context may not be fabricated.

data_quality_separate_from_market_behavi.reason: V3 separately records timestamp duplicates, out-of-order records and discontinuities; unavailable stale/delay/reconnect/correction/clock/feed semantics remain explicit UNKNOWN_UNPROVEN.

near_twin_counterexample.reason: Per-unit formation snapshots and causal evidence are prerequisite inputs. Actual corpus-scale near-twin comparison occurs only after enough full-depth units exist.

base_rate_denominator_readiness.reason: Ticker-day denominator inputs are persisted during evidence acquisition; corpus rates cannot be computed before the governed corpus exists.

formation_snapshot.reason: V3 resolves formation rows against full-envelope exact timestamp, not regular-stream index assumptions.

provenance_version_definition_lineage.reason: V3 attaches definition_version, exact source parents resolved by timestamp, exact time/range, known-at eligibility, derived parents, reason/features, availability, uncertainty and transition lineage to programmatic state/journey views.

auditable_output_parity_with_machine1.reason: Full parity is a corpus/final claim; V3 must first prove representative persisted objects and then run full governed evidence acquisition.
